propositions: Incomplete retirement operations leaving identical entries live and retired are detectable and safely completable at the validated write-bearing reconcile boundary, guarded after staleness validation but before remote issue fetch.

Recovery requires exact agreement between tombstone, forward entry, and reverse entry local IDs and Jira keys; any mismatch or corrupt state aborts safely without mutation and leaves evidence for retry.

Durable tombstone is the authoritative retirement intent; later automatic confirmations (200 response, clear_absent, same-key bind_confirm) do not implicitly resurrect; only explicit unretire removes the tombstone.
Create recovery moved to binding_recovery.py as an internal module owner; rich-text handler mutation through all_bindings() replaced with narrow S2 facade operation.

Pre-observation completion invocation belongs in reconcile.py at line 282 (after staleness gate, before first remote fetch), not in run_differs.py; configuration snapshot is composed post-fetch so that constraint is dropped.

Construction, load, reconcile-check, dry-run, preview, selection, and filtered operations perform zero writes from the retirement-completion operation; pre-existing create-recovery gate behavior unchanged.
